description: Pinned SimForge container image identifiers. Updated when a new thesis-tier benchmark run wants to commit to a specific immutable image digest. The GitHub Actions workflow .github/workflows/build-container.yml publishes images to GHCR on every push; the digests here are the ones that thesis numbers were measured against.

thesis_default.notes: First tagged image; digest will be filled in after the first GitHub Actions build lands. Used by sbatchs when SIMFORGE_USE_CONTAINER=1 is set without a specific SIMFORGE_CONTAINER_TAG override.
